description: Orca lets you run a fleet of bots with your own subscription (e.g. Claude Code, Grok, Agy, Codex). Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

latest_release.name: v1.4.271
latest_release.body:
[Previous release: 1.4.269](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.269): bots on eight more agents, a fuller phone app and a quieter Mac when idle.

## Set up your agents from your phone, and a lighter Orca ✨

This release puts nearly all of an agent's setup on your phone, cuts the repeated work Orca does when you have many bots, chats and workspaces, and lets you link more than one GitHub account.

- 📱 **Set up agents from your phone:** Connect Slack, Linear, GitHub, Google and Composio, edit automations, read an agent's soul, edit its memory and skills, add people to Who can ask, share an agent by link, or import one from OpenClaw, Hermes or another app. These need the matching mobile build.
- ⚡ **A lighter Orca with many chats open:** Terminal title and agent status changes no longer make the sidebar rescan every workspace or rebuild tab lists, bots with many chats skip thousands of database lookups per refresh, and animations you can't see pause.
- 🐙 **More than one GitHub account:** Link several GitHub accounts in Settings › GitHub. Each has its own default agent, Reconnect and Unlink, and the GitHub connector's menu offers Add another GitHub account.
- 💬 **Chats you can manage:** Delete a chat from its ⋯ menu or from Session History, mention folders with @, and let chats that hit a usage limit continue on their own once it resets.
- ⌨️ **Terminal agents that start cleanly:** Cursor terminals offer Approve for me (Cursor's Auto-review), and launch prompts wait for Claude's composer and are never typed into your shell after the agent CLI exits.

## Highlights

- 🤝 **Bot groups across computers:** One group can hold bots from this computer and your paired computers. @mention a bot on another computer and its answer appears under your post. Follow-up turns hand off to the members they @mention with no hand-off cap, and a member's automation can run in the room.
- 🤖 **Qwen Code for bots:** Bots can now run on Qwen Code.
- 📝 **Items that are easier to answer:** The item comment box has the composer's @mention and / pickers on desktop and phone, and clicking "Replying to" jumps to the question it answers.
- 🪟 **WSL hosts:** Codex accounts, folder moves, chat auto-naming and keep-awake work properly on WSL hosts.
- 📄 **Reading and reviewing:** Markdown keeps a comfortable reading width with the review rail beside it, PDFs scroll with PageUp/PageDown, and the Changes view stays visible and shows edits made in Edit mode.

### Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Continue after a usage limit is now on by default.** If you had turned it off, this update turns it on once. Turn it off again in Chat settings and it stays off.
- The phone features above need the matching mobile build.

---

## What's Changed

### 📱 Phone & mobile

*Set up an agent end to end from the phone: connectors for Slack, Linear, GitHub, Google and Composio, automations, soul, memory, skills and Who can ask, plus importing an agent from another app and sharing one by link. Session hand-off, Resume in New CLI and steadier pairing and buttons round it out. These need the matching mobile build.*

* feat(mobile): import an agent from OpenClaw, Hermes or another app on the phone by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46149
* fix(mobile): release Composio setup RPC clients when the last card leaves by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46192
* fix(mobile): defer bot avatar photo upload until Done so Cancel discards it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46195
* fix(mobile): re-read only the affected members in the group Items drawer by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46216
* feat(mobile): add Resume in New CLI to the chat header menu by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46129
* feat(mobile): show System default's usage card while a saved Claude account is selected by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/46144
* feat(mobile): hand off an Agent Session

detail.readme:
Orca

中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Français · Português · Türkçe · Русский

Bots inside your agent IDE.

Open source. Bring your own everything: your Claude Code or Codex, your local or remote machines, your tools. Ask from Slack or your phone. When it needs you, it's one tab away.

Download Orca  ·  Explore bots →

## Features
### Orca Bots Ask a bot in Slack, Linear, or GitHub to fix a bug, and come back to a tested pull request. It runs on your own Claude Code or Codex. Open its work in Orca to review it or step in. [Overview](https://orca.dev/bots) · [Security](https://orca.dev/docs/bots/security) · [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/bots)
### Chat or Terminal Run any agent in Chat UI or as the raw CLI, and move a conversation between the two without losing context. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/agents/native-chat)
### Orchestrate Agents Hand a big task to one agent. It splits the work, starts worker agents in their own workspaces, and brings their results back to you. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/orchestration)
### Run Anywhere Pair a Remote Orca Server, work on any SSH host, or give a worktree its own cloud VM. Your agents keep running when your laptop sleeps. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/ways-to-run)
### Mobile App Pair Orca with the mobile app to get pinged when an agent needs you, reply in chat, and keep work moving on any of your machines when you are away from your desk. [iOS App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/orca-ide/id6766130217) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.orca.app) · [Android APK](https://orca.dev/download/android) · [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/mobile)
### Review AI Output Review diffs, leave notes on exact changed lines, and send focused feedback back to an agent. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/review/annotate-ai-diff)
### Git Integration Draft commit messages and pull requests from the diff, then send failing checks or PR review comments back to an agent to fix. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/review/commit-push)
### Parallel Worktrees Quickly split tasks into isolated environments, so multiple agents can work side by side without interfering with each other. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/model/worktrees)
### Design Mode Click any element in Orca's browser to copy its HTML, styles, and selector, then paste it into your agent's chat. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/browser/design-mode)
### GitHub & Linear, Native See your GitHub and Linear tasks in one place, and start a workspace for each when you're ready to build. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/review/linear)
### Orca CLI Anything you can do in Orca, your agents can do too: create worktrees, start workers, drive the browser and desktop apps, and schedule automations, all from the command line. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/overview)
### Plugins Themes, editors, languages, and panels from the community, installed in a click. [Browse plugins →](https://orca.dev/plugins)
### Split Anything Put agents, terminals, browsers, and diffs side by side in split panes shaped to the task. [Docs →](https://orca.dev/docs/model/tabs-panes-splits)
**Also in the box:** - **[Bot Schedules & Triggers](https://orca.dev/docs/bots#put-it-on-a-schedule)**: run a bot every weekday at 9, or when a pull request opens, a check fails, or a webhook fires. - **[Bot Memory in Markdown](https://orca.dev/docs/bots/security#what-you-can-review)**: a bot's soul and memory are plain Markdown files (`SOUL.md`, `MEMORY.md`) you can read and edit. - **[Drag Files to Agents](https://orca.dev/docs/editing/file-explorer)**: drag files from the explorer, or images from your desktop, straight into an agent's prompt. - **[Jump Anywhere](https://orca.dev/docs/model/quick-open)**: one shortcut jumps to any workspace or tab across every repo and host. - **[Rich Previews](https://orca.dev/docs/editing/viewers)**: open images, PDFs, and Markdown right in the workspace, next to the agent that made them. - **[Mobile Emulator](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/overview#mobile-emulator)**: run an iOS Simulator or Android emulator beside your agent, and let it tap, type, and check its own work. - **[Dictation](https://orca.dev/docs/settings#voice)**: press a shortcut and talk. Orca types what you say into the agent's prompt or terminal. - **[Usage & Accounts](https://orca.dev/docs/agents/usage-tracking)**: see how much of your agent limits you've used and when they reset, and switch accounts without logging out. - **[Automations](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/automations)**: schedule prompts to run on any repo: nightly dependency bumps, weekly triage, flaky-test sweeps. - **[Computer Use](https://orca.dev/docs/cli/computer-use)**: when there's no CLI or API, agents can see and drive desktop apps and external browsers. - **And many, many more**: we ship daily, so this list is perpetually behind. The [changelog](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) is the real feature list. --- ## Supported Agents Works with **any CLI agent** — if it runs in a terminal, it runs in Orca.

Claude Code   Codex   Grok   Cursor   GitHub Copilot   Muse   DeepSeek Harness   ZCode   OpenCode   MiMo Code   Amp   OpenClaude   Antigravity   Pi   oh-my-pi   Hermes Agent   Devin   Goose   Auggie   Autohand Code   Charm   Cline   CodeBuddy   Codebuff   Freebuff   Command Code   Continue   Droid   Kilocode   Kimi   Kiro   Mistral Vibe   Qwen Code   Rovo Dev   + any CLI agent

--- ## Install ### Desktop — macOS, Windows, Linux - **[Download from orca.dev](https://orca.dev/download)** - Or grab a build directly: [macOS Apple Silicon](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-macos-arm64.dmg) · [macOS Intel](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-macos-x64.dmg) · [Windows (.exe)](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-windows-setup.exe) · [Linux AppImage](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest/download/orca-linux.AppImage) · [All builds](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/latest) _Or via a package manager:_ ```bash # macOS (Homebrew) # Always use the full name; bare `orca` is an unrelated Plotly cask. brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca # Upgrade an existing install brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca # Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first) brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc # Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source yay -S stably-orca-bin ``` ### Mobile App — iOS, Android Pair with your desktop app to monitor and steer your agents from your phone. - **iOS:** [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/orca-ide/id6766130217) - **Android:** [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.orca.app) · [Download APK](https://orca.dev/download/android) · [Install guide](https://orca.dev/docs/android-apk) --- ## Community & Support - **Discord:** Join the community on **[Discord](https://discord.gg/fzjDKHxv8Q)**. - **Twitter / X:** Follow **[@orca_build](https://x.com/orca_build)** for updates and announcements. - **WeChat:** Scan to join an Orca community WeChat group. - **Feedback & Ideas:** We ship fast. Missing something? [Request a new feature](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/issues). - **Privacy:** See the [privacy & telemetry docs](https://orca.dev/docs/telemetry) for what anonymous usage data Orca collects and how to opt out. - **Show Support:** [Star](https://github.com/stablyai/orca) this repo to follow along with our daily ships. --- ## Developing Want to contribute or run locally? See our [CONTRIBUTING.md](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
